scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Are you going to enter the ^0000FFDimensional Gap^000000?  Please use this Transport Device you see here.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
您要進入^0000FF次元裂縫^000000嗎？請使用這裡的傳送裝置。

scripts.text: What is the Dimensional Gap?
scripts.translation: 什麼是次元裂縫？

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
As you know we've already entered through the Dimensional Rift to get to Ash Vacuum right?  The Dimensional Gap is an expansion of that initial discovery.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
你知道，我們之前就是通過次元裂縫前往阿什·巴庫姆的，對吧？次元裂縫區域正是從那次發現進一步探索出來的。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
A member of the Expedition team found these backdoor passages to get through the Dimensional Rifts.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
遠征隊的一名成員發現了這些隱秘通道，可以穿過次元裂縫。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
This is like a Midgard Alliance version of the Bifrost bridge so it can connect us to different parts of the New World.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
這相當於米德加爾特聯盟修建的彩虹橋，能把我們連線到新世界的各個區域。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Time and space is distorted in the Dimensional Gap.  Not all passageways have been discovered so please be sure to use caution when entering an unverified area.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
次元裂縫中的時空扭曲不定，而且並非所有通道都已探明。進入未經確認的區域時務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Anyone who has become lost here has yet to return.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
在這裡迷路的人至今都未歸來。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
請多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Please use a ^0000FFTransport Device^000000 if you wish to travel through the dimensional rift.  The insides have not been fully explored yet so please be careful in there.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
若要穿越次元裂縫，請使用^0000FF傳送裝置^000000。裂縫內部尚未完全探明，請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Allied Forces Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to the Allied Forces ^0000FFExpedition Camp^000000 in Jotunheim.
scripts.translation:
[聯合軍士兵]
這條次元裂縫連線著約頓海姆的聯合軍^0000FF遠征營地^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allied Forces Soldier]
Do not worry, it has been set up after testing hundreds of experiments for safe teleportation.
scripts.translation:
[聯合軍士兵]
請放心，這臺裝置經過數百次測試，確認可以安全傳送後才投入使用。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to ^0000FFMorocc^000000 back in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克士兵]
這條次元裂縫連線著米德加爾特後方的^0000FF夢羅克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
This is the fastest gateway back to our world.  The area is still destroyed but restoration efforts will soon be on the way.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克士兵]
這是返回我們世界最快的通道。這裡雖仍是一片廢墟，但很快就會開始重建。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to the south of ^0000FFBifrost^000000.  It enables quick travel to the Splendide frontline.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域士兵]
這條次元裂縫連線著^0000FF比弗羅斯特^000000的南部。
它可以讓我們快速前往輝煌領域的前線。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
If we use it properly, it enables us to advance more easily to the capital of the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域士兵]
只要善加利用這條通道，我們就能更輕鬆地推進到薩法族的首都。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
The Mayor has asked us to cooperate as best we can instead of fighting, so I'm under orders not to do anything.  Since we have a common enemy we won't fight the Sapha... for now...
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域士兵]
市長命令我們儘可能與薩法族合作，避免衝突，所以我奉命按兵不動。既然我們有共同的敵人，暫時就不會和薩法族交戰...

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Sapha]
This dimensional rift is connected to the southern area of the ^0000FFKamidal Mountains^000000 in El Dicastes.  I just dropped by for my research, but it is incredible.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的薩法族]
這條次元裂縫連線著埃爾迪卡特斯的^0000FF卡米達爾山脈^000000南部。我只是順道來做研究，沒想到這裡竟如此驚人。

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Sapha]
Moreover it is next to the Laphine capital..... Hmm... Do not worry, I do not want to fight in such a place.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的薩法族]
而且這裡緊鄰拉菲涅族的首都.....嗯...別擔心，我可不想在這種地方打起來。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
Welcome.  I am in charge of logistics to take care of your items in this weird place.  Do you need to access your storage?
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管]
歡迎。我負責管理這裡的物資和倉儲。需要使用倉庫嗎？

scripts.text: Open Storage 200 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 開啟倉庫（200 Zeny）

scripts.text: No Thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
You are not yet qualified to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管]
您還不符合使用倉庫的條件。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
You need at least 200 zeny to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管]
使用倉庫至少需要200 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
Let me know if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管]
如果您改變主意了，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Who're you?
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
What do you want?
You looking something in
particular?
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
你想幹什麼？
你在找什麼特別的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
So some enforcers have been
cracking down on merchants lately.
I can not sell anything.
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
最近執法者在嚴查商人，我什麼東西都賣不出去。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Come here...
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
過來...

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
I knew you would be here!!
No illegal trading is allowed
here!
Don't you know?
scripts.translation:
[緊張兮兮的騎士]
我就知道你會在這裡！
這裡不準非法交易！
你不知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Says who?
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
誰規定的？

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Ok, then show me your permit.
scripts.translation:
[神經緊張的騎士]
好吧，那就出示一下你的許可證。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Permit?
No one's in charge here!
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
許可證？
這裡又沒人管！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You! If you need anything come to
me ok?
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
喂！有需要就來找我，知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
I will catch you!
scripts.translation:
[緊張兮兮的騎士]
我一定會抓住你的！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Cold juice!
Apple, grape, orange~
Anything you want!
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
冰鎮果汁！
蘋果、葡萄、橙子口味都有~
想喝什麼儘管挑！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Sweet potato, dumpling~
Here we have delicious desserts~
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
烤紅薯、餃子~
還有各種美味甜點~

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You need to pay a toll to get past here.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
你要通過這裡，得交過路費。

scripts.text: What toll?
scripts.translation: 什麼過路費？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You did not know?
500 zeny
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
你不知道嗎？
500 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
You there!
Stop right there!
scripts.translation:
[神經緊張的騎士]
喂！
站住！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Ugh! How are you always following me?
Got some kind of crush on me or something? I don't think you and I make a good match...
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
嘖！你怎麼總跟著我？
該不會是對我有意思吧？我可不覺得咱倆合適...

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Why don't we find out then?
scripts.translation:
[緊張兮兮的騎士]
那不如試試看？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
That's it no more talking.
I'm outta here~
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
行了，不跟你廢話了。
我先走啦~

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Keep running you sneaky coward!
scripts.translation:
[緊張兮兮的騎士]
有種別跑，你這個狡猾的膽小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
500 zeny
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
500 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You are lucky that you have met up
with me.
Who am I?
I'm here to become a merchant
King.
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
能遇見我，算你走運。
我是誰？
我來這裡是為了將來成為商界之王。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
I might be working a street stall
now but I'll have an actual shop
some day.
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
我現在雖然只擺著路邊攤，
但總有一天會開一家正經店鋪。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
It's my first day so I'm having a
major sale.
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
今天是我開張第一天，所有商品大減價！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Let's see I've got a...
Ring of something!
Sword of stuff!
A backpack of some sort!
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
讓我看看...我這兒有：
什麼什麼戒指！
什麼什麼劍！
還有一個不知名的背包！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Tell me if you need anything,
scripts.translation:
[王子卡內特]
需要什麼儘管告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
What are you doing here?
This is my spot for a shop
Get outta my turf!
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
你在這裡做什麼？
這是我的攤位。
滾出我的地盤！

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Bah!!
You're gonna regret those words!
scripts.translation:
[神經緊張的騎士]
哼！！
你會後悔說這種話的！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
I'm shaking...
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
我在發抖...

scripts.text:
[Curious Knight]
The Royal Guard in here
was desperate for help.
We entered through a secret place
in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[好奇的騎士]
這裡的皇家衛士急需援助。
我們是從宮殿的一處秘密通道進來的。

scripts.text:
[Curious Knight]
We were whisked away here...
No idea where I am but I have to
establish a base here for the
Knighthood.
scripts.translation:
[好奇的騎士]
我們突然就被帶到了這裡...
我不知道這是哪裡，但必須在此建立騎士團的據點。

scripts.text:
[Confused Thief]
One minute I'm in a bar...
The next minute I'm here...
What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[困惑的盜賊]
前一刻我還在酒館...
轉眼就到了這裡...
這到底是什麼地方？

scripts.text:
[Confused Thief]
There's no night or day in here.
Hmm, something has to be valuable
in this place...
scripts.translation:
[困惑的盜賊]
這裡沒有白天和黑夜之分。
嗯，這個地方一定有什麼值錢的東西...

scripts.text:
[Adventurous Rafflesia]
No no this has to be Thanatos
Tower...
I sense dark magic here.
scripts.translation:
[愛冒險的大王花]
不，這裡一定是塔納托斯之塔...
我感受到了黑暗魔力。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Oh, we're back here again.
I cannot find a way out!
We are trapped in this maze!
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
哎呀，我們又回到這裡了。
我找不到出口！
我們被困在這個迷宮裡了！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Is this place the famous Prontera?
It is dark just like a big city!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
這裡是著名的普隆德拉嗎？
黑漆漆的，倒真像一座大城市！

scripts.text:
[Traveller]
I hear a ticking clock.
This place must be Geffen!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我聽見了時鐘的滴答聲。
這裡一定是吉芬！
